title: Start
body:
While walking, Guada notices a coin purse lying on the ground.
Some people around her seem to recognize her and watch closely.
What is she going to do?
[[ A. She should pocket the money and move on.|option10]]
[[ B. Guada should locate the owner and give it back.|option11]]
[[ C. She should turn it over to nearby personnel.|option12]]
